summary_md:
# “En av de svartaste svanar jag sett”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this EFN Morgon episode the hosts mostly talk about Jensen Huang stepping down as Nvidia CEO after infidelity scandals with espionage links, which they call one of the blackest swans they have seen. They note that money appears to be rotating to AMD and Broadcom rather than leaving the market, while Nvidia-funded neoclouds (CoreWeave, Nebius) fell. In Sweden, Asmodee's Q2 report beat consensus by a wide margin, and they also cover Anthropic's IPO, SpaceX-Tesla merger rumours, Samsung's rumoured bid for Modine and the read-across to Munters.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 ASMDEE-B — Asmodee | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Q2 results beat consensus by a wide margin on organic growth, profit and margin; stock up 60%+ YTD ahead of the report.

#### Reasoning

Hosts called the report 'superstark': adj. result EUR 106m vs 89m consensus, organic growth 33.3% vs 19.3%, growth in both board games and Pokémon trading cards, and the 18.1% adj. EBITDA margin target reached. Tariff refunds (EUR 5.1m) flattered the result. Hosts asked whether the momentum can continue but gave no explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth falls back toward low teens
- if Pokémon card demand cools
- if the margin depended on one-off tariff refunds

> *"Och som sagt, superstark rapport igen vad det ser ut här på på siffrorna."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

CEO exit amid scandals with espionage links; risk of staff departures, Senate testimony and uncertainty over long-term investments.

#### Reasoning

Hosts frame the episode as a black swan. Key-person risk: employees joined because of Huang and may leave or start new ventures. National-security probe and Lutnick testimony add regulatory risk. The stock reaction was moderated, but long-term consequences are unclear.

#### Sell Triggers

- if key engineers leave en masse
- if export-control sanctions follow the Senate hearings

> *"Vi pratar svarta svanar ibland på börsen. Det här är en av de svartaste."*

---

### 🟠 AMD — AMD | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

A cited fund manager says AMD can gain ground on Nvidia after Huang's exit; market cap has risen as capital rotates.

#### Reasoning

Cited fund-manager opinion, not the hosts' own view: Nvidia's leadership vacuum may let AMD under Lisa Su take share. The hosts observe that AMD and Broadcom gained about what Nvidia lost.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nvidia stabilises quickly under a new CEO

> *"Jag fick en spaning från en förvaltare som sa att AMD kan flytta fram."*

---

### 🟠 MTRS — Munters | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Samsung's rumoured bid for its US peer Modine could spill over to Munters at the Stockholm open.

#### Reasoning

M&A read-across: a data center cooling peer drew a takeover bid and rose 28%. Munters has fallen this year and could re-rate on the sector valuation signal. Hosts will watch the open; this is speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Samsung bid rumour is denied

> *"Vi får se om det spiller över på Stockholmsbörsen i dag."*

---
